rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1200, lr=0.0023, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=7, proj_kernel=7, img_kernel=9, proj_sx=1.0, proj_sy=2.0, proj_sr=0.02, img_sx=3.5, img_sy=3.5, img_sr=0.02, rationale=iter-16: ONE knob changed vs the iter-15 WIN base (image-domain bilateral WINDOW SIZE img_kernel 7->9); all 18 other fields held IDENTICAL to demo_dl_dual_domain_bilateral_n2i_iter_15.json (img_sx/img_sy=3.5, img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02 LOOSE demo-correct, proj_n_bf=1, proj_kernel=7, proj_sx/sy=1.0/2.0, proj_sr=0.02, lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42 -> identical seed=42 val split, directly comparable to iter-15 SSIM 0.8246 / hr 0.3323 / PSNR 20.17). KEEP UNLOCKING THE BINDING CONSTRAINT (the kernel, NOT the sigma). Read iter-14->15 BY SSIM (the surface the spatial-smoothing thread moves; hr stays pinned ~0.332 at the 64-view-FBP noise-floor ceiling): iter-15 widened img_kernel 5->7 and LIFTED SSIM 0.8035->0.8246 (+0.0211 -- the largest single-iter lift since iter-2, BIGGER than any sigma step), while hr stayed FLAT 0.3320->0.3323 and PSNR flat 20.17->20.17. So the kernel WINDOW, not the sigma, is the live lever right now -- the WIN was a kernel change. SIGMA/KERNEL COUPLING READ: img_sx=3.5 is the requested Gaussian spatial sigma; a Gaussian needs roughly +/-2*sigma=+/-7px of support to be well-represented, but img_kernel=7 gives only a +/-3px window -- the half-window (3) is STILL SMALLER than sigma (3.5), so the kernel=7 window STILL TRUNCATES the img_sx=3.5 Gaussian. The +0.0211 lift at iter-15 came purely from letting the EXISTING sigma=3.5 reach a bit farther (5px->7px window); since the window remains the binding constraint (3 < 3.5), widening it ONE more notch should keep paying off. FAILURE MODE this iter addresses: at kernel=7 the img_sx=3.5 spatial weight is still clipped at the +/-3px window edge -- the BF cannot yet average over the full +/-4px neighborhood the sigma=3.5 requests. The unlock is to widen the WINDOW again, not the sigma. HYPOTHESIS (img-kernel-2): widening img_kernel 7->9 enlarges the per-BF window from +/-3px to +/-4px so the img_sx=3.5 spatial Gaussian can finally average over (most of) the neighborhood it requests -> lifts SSIM past iter-15 0.8246 on the SAME seed=42 split. Expect hr to stay pinned ~0.332 (this is an SSIM-only structural-similarity lever bounded by the 64-view-FBP noise floor -- hr has been flat ~0.332 across the entire spatial-smoothing thread iter-13/14/15). If SSIM SATURATES or regresses here, the kernel window has finally caught up to the sigma=3.5 support and the image-domain spatial denoising is exhausted at the ~0.82-0.83 SSIM / ~0.33 hr substrate ceiling -- a clean ceiling-doc result, and iter-17 would then RE-LIBERATE the sigma (img_sx/img_sy 3.5->4.5, now that kernel=9 admits a wider sigma) to test whether the larger window unlocks more sigma headroom. Chose img_kernel 7->9 (continue the just-proven WINNING lever -- the kernel, which delivered +0.0211) over (a) pushing img_sx/img_sy 3.5->4.5 NOW (the sigma is still window-truncated at kernel=7, so widening sigma further inside a window that only reaches +/-3px requests support the window cannot deliver -- that is the exact saturation regime iter-14 hit; widen the window FIRST, then re-liberate sigma at iter-17 if the kernel saturates), (b) proj_sr/proj_kernel/proj_n_bf (whole proj domain confirmed flat at iter-11/12 -- symmetry trap, wasted), (c) img_sr (exhausted + substrate-confirmed WRONG-direction -- tightening to 0.0005 collapsed hr 0.3335->0.1998 at iter-4 -- FORBIDDEN, stays LOOSE 0.02), (d) img_n_bf/n_iter/pretrain_epochs/seed/val_n (all DEAD FLAT / variance-only, exhausted), (e) grad_clip (mandatory overflow guard at 1.0, not a quality lever). Held fixed at iter-15 values: img_sx=3.5/img_sy=3.5, img_n_bf=7, img_sr=0.02 (LOOSE, demo-correct), proj_n_bf=1, proj_kernel=7, proj_sr=0.02, proj_sx=1.0/proj_sy=2.0, lr=2.3e-3, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, n_iter=400, train_n=200, val_n=6, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42. Wall: iter-15 ran 515 s at img_kernel=7; a 9-px image-BF window is modestly slower per step than a 7-px window (the image-domain conv is a small fraction of the 128-view FBP+proj per-step cost) -- n_iter/val_n kept at iter-15 values, so wall stays comfortably under the 1800 s sbatch wall and the 1200 s outer_wall_s internal guard (under the 15-min budget). PER-IMAGE bilateral N2I, AGENT4CT_DATASET=phantoms; warm_start STAYS ON; do NOT revert to amortized; do NOT tighten img_sr.
